whenToUse: Order complete screens or order detail pages.
There are several items and the total comes first.
Discounts and shipping affect the amount.
whenNotToUse: There's only one item (just show the total).
The cart before payment (use an editable list).
Documents with a fixed format, such as tax invoices.

alternatives.name: Success Screen
alternatives.reason: Showing the result and next steps together.

accessibility: The expand items button has aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Total rows pair names and amounts in a dl.
Discounts have a minus sign, so they're clear without color.
tabular-nums lines up the digits of amounts.
